heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
At the semantic classification step, use `typesafe triage`; the exact recipe
lives in the inbox-triage reference. Pass explicit thread evidence only; the
helper does not acquire or mutate mail.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
After reading the decision-relevant threads, run `typesafe triage` with
`threads` containing stable `id`, `subject`, and complete `evidence` fields. Use
its outcome, owner, liability, and urgency judgments as resolution
recommendations. Standing rules, approvals, frozen message IDs, and every
mailbox action remain owned by this workflow.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
After acquisition produces identity-bound evidence, run `typesafe school`
with stable source records and proposed facts, ISO dates, and audiences linked
through `sourceIds`. Feed its source-support judgments into the existing typed
review and reconciliation path. Source precedence, conflicts, approvals, and
Calendar actions remain owned here.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
At the Sort step, run `typesafe brief` with gathered `items` containing stable
`id`, decision text, and `evidenceRefs`. Use the attention, resolved, and safe
omission judgments to propose the two lists and their order, then perform the
required live-thread checks. Calendar classification, rendering, and actions
remain owned by this skill.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
After candidates pass the exact gates, use `typesafe verify` for material
qualitative claims, supplying stable sources and claims with exact source
quotes. Use `typesafe rank` to score viable candidates on explicit ordered
dimensions and caller-defined levels. The caller derives the final order; exact
stock, variant, region, dimensions, price, delivery, and visual verification
remain owned here.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
After `goplaces` resolves a small candidate set, use `typesafe rank` for
qualitative relevance. Supply stable candidate and dimension IDs, complete
candidate evidence in `text`, and ordered levels for every dimension. Consume
the returned per-dimension scores; exact identity, routes, distance, duration,
traffic, hours, and final ordering remain on `goplaces`.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
After the archive query yields a bounded candidate set, use `typesafe rank`
for semantic relevance. Supply stable message and dimension IDs, complete
candidate evidence in `text`, and ordered levels for every dimension. Consume
the returned per-dimension scores; msgvault acquisition, exact filters, archive
operations, and final ordering remain owned here.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
Extract or OCR the PDF first. For source-preserving Markdown, pass
`typesafe structure` source-ordered lines with stable `id`, exact `text`, and
`gapBefore`. For bounded claims, pass `typesafe verify` stable sources plus
claims whose exact quote occurs in the named source. Preserve extracted text and
page references; TypeSafe supplies interpretation, not extraction.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
After removing stale premises, run `typesafe bucket` with `items` containing
stable `id`, item text, and `evidenceRefs`. Use its independent need and
complexity judgments as proposed bucket placements. Axis definitions, requested
order, sign-off markers, and any `.session` moves remain owned by this skill.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
Before finalizing, use `typesafe verify` for bounded claims whose support
depends on relating evidence. Supply stable sources and claims with `sourceId`
and an exact quote that occurs in the source. Treat the returned relation as a
support judgment, not provenance; versions, dates, URLs, logs, and citations
still require direct verification.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
Before selecting optional discipline passes, run `typesafe review` with the
full `change` and `context`. Use its six applicability judgments to choose
optional passes; always run required and user-requested passes, and send
uncertain cases to the lead. TypeSafe does not judge findings: the lead still
verifies every mechanism against the code and follows the verifier rules above.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
Classify one review comment or thread per `typesafe feedback` invocation. Put
the feedback text in `feedback`; put its stable thread ID and all applicable
diff, discussion, and verification evidence in `context`, retaining that mapping
in the caller. Consume the actionable, informational, ambiguous, or unresolved
choice inside the existing feedback workflow; fixes, replies, resolution, and
pushes remain owned here.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
When drafted content needs a semantic behavior judgment, run `typesafe pulse`
with `items` containing stable `id`, `currentText`, `proposedText`, and all
applicable `exactFacts` as stable `{ id, text }` entries. Consume the typed
judgment before validation and preserve the returned facts unchanged. Lifecycle,
compatibility, manifests, formatting, and repository checks remain authoritative.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
For semantic expectations that cannot be checked deterministically, run
`typesafe grade` with `items` containing stable assertion `id`, `expectation`,
and all applicable `evidence`. Use each support, contradiction, or insufficiency
judgment when writing `grading.json`; TypeSafe does not generate the required
explanation. Prefer programmatic checks, and preserve this grader's `text`,
`passed`, and `evidence` contract.

heading: TypeSafe judgments
content:
When an agent application needs typed semantic decisions, load the installed
`typesafe-ai` skill and its current JavaScript API guide before designing the
decision boundary. Use the TypeSafe API at the server-side application boundary;
keep exact rules, state transitions, approvals, and side effects in application
code. The local `typesafe` CLI is an operator tool, not a deployed interface.
